notes.title: Tomb Stalkers Available Now!
notes.content:
After 3 years of development between almost 10 years since the development beginning, Tomb Stalker is now Available on Steam!

Since we resume the development in early this year where we left in 2016, our main challenge was to deliver the most solid experience possible. Other challenges came like Steam Next Fest not performing visibility results as expected, but we managed to try to overcome somehow.

[b]About the Game[/b]

[p]The lost city of [b]EL DORADO[/b] has been found. You've been sent by the British Museum with the mission to recover the lost treasures that have been there for centuries... But no one knew the city was inhabited. The chance to return with riches and fame are in your hands. [/p][p]Will you face the challenge? 
[/p][p][b]Gameplay Description:[/b] 
[/p][p]Tomb Stalkers is an Action Arcade Puzzle game like few with fast paced game mechanics. Walk around the tombs to open them and reveal their content, you require to get a key and a relic to be able to unlock the exit to the next level. But beware, the sorceress (living, undead and even gods) minions are upon you with their unique and annoying abilities. Even her will join to the chase if is provoked enough! Each scenario contains secrets and traps to be aware of in your search of riches and fame. 
[/p][p][b]Features:[/b] 
[/p][list][*][p]2 Player Co-op game [/p][/*][*][p]25 levels in 5 different scenarios. [/p][/*][*][p]3 game modes [/p][list][*][p]Arcade Mode: Beat the 25 Levels and try to achieve the highest Score! [/p][/*][*][p]Original Mode: Play with different game rules each stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Survival: 1 Life, one chance, are you up for the greatest challenge? [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Are you able to unlock the secret ending? 
 [/p][/*][*][p]Compatible with Steam Deck, Steam Input and Steam Remote Play[/p][/*][/list]

[b]About the The Soundtrack:[/b]

Consist in 14 tracks of +10 minutes of music, in .MP3 and .WAV.

[b]About the The Founders Edition:[/b]

Consist in a bundle with the game and the soundtrack with a 10% off.

[b]Future updates:[/b]

It will depend on how de game perform on sales, but at least 2 major free updates are planned:

[list]
[*] Director's Cut: if the game sells 2K copies, we will include the cut content plus some extras which consists in:
- Unlockable Game gallery
- Unlockable characters to play with
- a new game mode: Speed run Mode. 
- New achievements to unlock.
[*] Infinite Tomb: this major update will include a new game: Infinite Tomb, which will be an evolution of survival mode and more achievements to unlock. It will be developed after the release of Director's Cut update.
[/list]

To all the potential buyers, we hope you enjoy the game and let us know how to improve it.
Kind Regards
Gara Rosales González
Itchy Games

notes.title: Tomb Stalkers release date announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Tomb Stalkers, an arcade action puzzle game, will be launching on Steam on [b]December 6th 2024[/b].

In Tomb Stalkers, players venture into El Dorado to recover ancient treasures by unlocking tomb exits with keys and relics while dodging sorceress minions and traps. The game offers 25 levels, co-op mode, three gameplay modes, and hidden secrets.

Following the experience of the Steam Next Fest, there have been several changes regarding the game:
[list]
[*] Japanese and Korean (text only) have been added to the available languages.
[*] The gallery mode and character selection have been trimmed. They could be added as a free update depending on sales performance.
[*] Original Mode now implements one or more random rules on each level (time limit, all mummies can spawn at once, switch between normal lighting, darkness or fog ambience).
[*] Survival Mode now has the option to use either Arcade rules or Original Mode.
[*] Release date has been moved up to Friday, [b]December 6th 2024, priced at 14.99 USD / 14.99 €[/b].
[/list]

The demo version of the game is still currently available for free in case you want to get a small taste of the full experience.

[p][b]Features:[/b] 
[/p][list][*][p]2 Player Co-op game [/p][/*][*][p]25 levels in 5 different scenarios. [/p][/*][*][p]3 game modes [/p][list][*][p]Arcade Mode: Beat the 25 Levels and try to achieve the highest Score! [/p][/*][*][p]Original Mode: Play with different game rules each stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Survival: 1 Life, one chance, are you up for the greatest challenge? [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Are you able to unlock the secret ending? 
 [/p][/*][*][p]Compatible with Steam Deck, Steam Input and Steam Remote Play[/p][/*][/list]

Cheers!
Gara Rosales González
Itchy Games

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
This week we've made a sprint to get an even more polished and pleasant demo experience for the Steam Next Fest. Hope you like it!

[list]
[*] Enhanced game general performance
[*] Enhanced visuals in several areas.
[*] Enhanced highlighting system, more clear and less invasive.
[*] Stages and other game scenes (Continue and Stage Clear) feels more alive with details/props, several of them, interactive.
[*] Improved game control system.
[*] Pause menu can be controlled only by the player who invokes it (before only player 1 interacted with the pause menu).
[*] Added navigation controls context in main menu (using keyboard or any kind of gamepad).
[*] Removed feature: join Second player any moment in the game (via local or Steam Remote Play) due to control assigning issues. Number of players must be set before beginning the game, also joining via Steam Remote Play.
[/list]

Kind Regards,
Gara Rosales González
Itchy Games

notes.title: Last Demo patch before Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

- Blue Mummy Behavior: now mummies repair tombs, which is their expected behavior/skill... but it has never fixed properly until now.
- Guardian (Boss) Behavior: in some cases, guardian lost his spear until he tries to throw a spear again. This happened when guardian is damaged just after throwing the spear. Now is solved.
- seems the Wishlist button was not active in the last update. So now is active.
- Graphics: X-Ray effect's resolution has been raised, 2x for single player and 1.5x for multiplayer (due to there are 2 cameras rendering).
- Changed blue Mummies spawn amount and spawn priority
- Music changes when Sorceress is spawned, turns to previous Music theme if the timer is not ran out. that way the player is aware when the sorceress is in the area (Most dangerous enemy to face in the game, due to she forces you to restart the level if she catches you).

notes.title: Tomb Stalker demo is Out!
notes.content:
After 3 years of development (distributed in almost 10 years from development beginning to its actual state), now we've got an official demo to share to the world.

This demo includes the [b]Arcade mode[/b] (one of the 3 official game modes which the game will include in the final version), [b]where you can try 6 of the 25 levels from 3 of the 5 different scenarios[/b], including a boss fight. That way you can have a small taste of the gameplay and see enough content from the final version. Also, you can replay it selecting [b]4 of the difficulty levels you can choose which changes the enemy spawn speed and the scene visual help[/b]. The game can be played[b] up to 2 players locally and via Steam Remote Play[/b]. So don't be afraid to play with your friends ([b]Steam Remote Play does not require the other player to have a copy of the game[/b]).

[b]This demo was supposed to be launched the 3rd October[/b], but releasing it now will help us to fine-tune and solve any emerging issues to get even better prepared for the [b]October Steam Next Fest[/b]. [b]So, if you find any kind of bug while you play, you've got an In-Game Bug reporter in main menu and pause menu[/b], these bugs reports will be sent to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F7WUnPE57rE]Discord Channel[/url]. 
You can also report the bugs you find in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536990/discussions/0/4844273660405019961/]this topic in our Community Hub[/url].

Speaking of which, we want to inform you that we're making a [b]"Wishlist crowdfunding"[/b] where the more whish lists we get, the more post-launch content we'll release. These post-launch features will be included as a free update when they're done.

[h1]Wishlist Crowdfunding Goals:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]10K Wishlist:[/b] New game mode, [b]Speed Run Mode[/b]. Race against the clock to be the fastest player in the world beating the game. it will also include several speed run rules like ANY%, 100%, No Hit, No miss... which you can combine to participate. in case you break the rules, it will be an instant game over. this update will include new achievements to unlock for the new game mode.
[*][b]20K Wishlist:[/b] Character Pack. New characters and skins will be added to unlock.
[*][b]30K Wishlist:[/b] New game Mode, [b]Infinite Tomb Mode[/b]. An advanced version of the survival mode, One life, no continues and procedural generated levels, one harder and bigger than the last one. how many levels you will beat until get defeated?. It will also include new achievements for this game mode in particular.
[*]More to be revealed soon depending on Wishlist performance.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy playing this game as we enjoyed developing it.
[b]And remember to Wishlist and send any significative feedback![/b]

Kind Regards,
Gara Rosales Gonzalez
Itchy Games

notes.title: See you at the October Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The true spiritual successor of Oh Mummy! (1984) is here!

Tomb Stalkers is an Action Arcade Puzzle game like few with fast paced game mechanics. Walk around the tombs to open them and reveal their content, you require to get a key and a relic to be able to unlock the exit to the next level. But beware, the sorceress (living, undead and even gods) minions are upon you with their unique and annoying abilities. Even her will join to the chase if is provoked enough! Each scenario contains secrets and traps to be aware of (and use against your enemies in your search of riches and fame.

Compared with its predecessor, Tomb Stalkers have the following new features:

[list]
[*] updated visuals: not only the game is totally and beautifully hand-painted in 3D, but levels have diverse layouts, conditions and traps.
[*] More type of enemies (8), each one with their unique behavior. 
[*] 5 times more levels (25, original has 5 and loops), divided in 4 different scenarios with their own gimmicks and traps and guarded by bosses.
[*] Way more items to pick up from tombs: treasure chests, 1 ups and the Gems (the evolution of Scrolls) each gem has a color and a power, some beneficial and some will make your situation more challenging.
[*] 3 game modes: each one with their own rules; Arcade, Original and Survival.
[*] 2 endings depending on your performance.
[*] Unlockable characters
[*] up to Two players locally or via Steam Remote Play
[*] Gallery mode.
[/list]

it has been near 3 years of development (and counting) with ups and downs. But we're quite in the right track to offer a quite new experience based on a 40 year old game and release it sooner than you expect.

Regarding the Steam demo, it will have the following features:
[list]
[*] Arcade mode only
[*] 6 levels, 2 crypt levels, 2 Golden Temple levels and 2 Royal Garden levels, including a boss fight.
[*] 4 difficulty levels.
[*] Two players locally and via Steam Remote Play.
[*] Compatibility with Steam Input and any possible controller.
[*] Compatibility with Steam Deck.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it, send feedback, Wishlist if you like, and await for the final version.

Kind Regards,
Gara Rosales Gonzalez
